coptic: Ⲛⲉⲕⲛⲁⲓ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩϯ: ϩⲁⲛⲁⲧϭⲓⲏ̀ⲡⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ: ⲥⲉⲟϣ ⲉ̀ⲙⲁϣⲱ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ.

translations.english: Your mercies O my God, are countless, and exceedingly plenteous, are Your compassion.
translations.arabic: مراحمك يا إلهي، غير محصاة، وكثيرة جداً، هي رأفاتك.

transliterations.english: Neknai o Panoti: hanatchi-eepi emmoou: seosh emasho: enje nekmetshenheet.

sung.english: Your mercies O my God, are countless, and exceedingly plenteous, are Your compassions.

coptic: Ⲛⲓⲧⲉⲗⲧⲓⲗⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲩⲛϩⲱⲟⲩ: ⲥⲉⲏⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲧⲕ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲡⲓⲕⲉϣⲱ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ: ⲥⲉⲭⲏ ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲕⲃⲁⲗ.

translations.english: All the rain drops, are counted by You, and the sand of the sea, is before Your eyes.
translations.arabic: قطرات المطر، محصاة عندك جميعها، ورمل البحر، كائن أمام عينيك.

transliterations.english: Niteltili emmounhoou: se-eep entotk teerou: pikesho ente efiom: sekee nahren nekval.

coptic: Ⲓⲉ ⲁⲩⲏⲣ ⲙⲁⲗⲗⲟⲛ: ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲁⲯⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲙ̀ⲑⲟ Ⲡⲁϭⲟⲓⲥ.

translations.english: How much more are, the sins of my soul, manifest before You, O my Lord.
translations.arabic: فكم بالحري، خطايا نفسي، هذه الظاهرة، أمامك يا ربي.

transliterations.english: Ie aveer mallon: ninovi ente tapsishee: nai ethowonh evol: empekemtho Pashois.

coptic: Ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲁⲧⲟⲩ: Ⲡⲁϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲕⲉⲣⲡⲟⲩⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀: ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣϯϩ̀ⲑⲏⲕ: ⲉ̀ⲛⲁⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ.

translations.english: The sins that I have committed, do not remember my Lord, and do not count, my iniquities.
translations.arabic: الخطايا التي صنعتها، يا ربي لا تذكرها، ولا تحسب، آثامي.

transliterations.english: Ninovi etaiatou: Pashois ennekerpoumevi: outhe emperti-ehtheek: ena-anomia.

coptic: Ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲧⲉⲗⲱⲛⲏⲥ ⲁⲕⲥⲟⲧⲡϥ: ϯⲡⲟⲣⲛⲏ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲥⲟⲛⲓ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ: Ⲡⲁϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲁⲕⲉⲣⲡⲉϥⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀.

translations.english: For You have chosen the publican, and the adulteress You have saved, and the right-hand thief, my Lord You have remembered.
translations.arabic: فإن العشار إخترته، والزانية خلصتها، واللص اليمين، يا سيدي ذكرته.

transliterations.english: Je pitelonees aksotpf: tipornee aksoti emmos: pisoni etsaouinam: Pashois akerpefmevi.

sung.english: For You have chosen the publican, and the adulteress You have saved, and the right hand thief, my Lord You have remembered.

coptic: Ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ϩⲱ Ⲡⲁϭⲟⲓⲥ: ϧⲁ ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ: ⲙⲁⲧ̀ⲥⲁⲃⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲓ̀ⲣⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲧⲁⲛⲟⲓⲁ.

translations.english: And me too, the sinner, teach me O my Master, to offer repentance.
translations.arabic: وأنا أيضاً الخاطئ، يا سيدي، علمني، أن أصنع توبة.

transliterations.english: Anok ho Pashois: kha pirefernovi: ma-etsavoi enta-iri: enoumetanoia.

sung.english: And I too, the sinner, teach me O my Lord, to offer repentance.

coptic: Ϫⲉ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲁⲛ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟϥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲥⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲏ.

translations.english: For You do not desire, the death of a sinner, but rather that he returns, and that his soul may live.
translations.arabic: لأنك لا تشاء، موت الخاطئ، مثل أن يرجع، وتحيا نفسه.

transliterations.english: Je ekowosh emefmou an: empirefernovi: emefreeti enteftastof: entesonkh enje tefpsishee.

coptic: Ⲙⲁⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟⲛ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ.

translations.english: Restore us O God, to Your salvation, and deal with us, according to Your goodness.
translations.arabic: ردنا يا الله، إلى خلاصك، وعاملنا، كصلاحك.

transliterations.english: Mataston Efnoti: ekhoun epekougai: arioui neman: kata tekmetaghathos.

coptic: Ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ ⲟⲩⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲏⲧ: ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲧⲁϩⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲭⲱⲗⲉⲙ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ.

translations.english: For You are good, and merciful, let Your compassion, speedily come to us.
translations.arabic: لأنك أنت صالح، ورحوم، فلتدركنا، رأفاتك سريعاً.

transliterations.english: Je enthok o-aghathos: o-woh ennaeet: maroutahon enkolem: enje nekmetshenheet.

coptic: Ϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ϧⲁⲣⲟⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ: Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓ.

translations.english: Have compassion upon us all, O Lord God our Savior, and have mercy upon us, according to Your great mercy.
translations.arabic: ترأف علينا كلنا، أيها الرب الإله، مخلصنا وإرحمنا، كعظيم رحمتك.

transliterations.english: Shenheet kharon teeren: Epshois Efnoti Pensoteer: o-woh nai nan: kata peknishti ennai.

coptic: Ⲛⲁⲓ ⲕ̀ⲓ̀ⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀: ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲏⲃ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ: ⲉⲕⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲙⲏϯ: ⲉⲕⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲕϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.

translations.english: Remember those, O Christ our Master, be among us, and proclaim and say.
translations.arabic: هؤلاء أذكرهم، يا سيدنا المسيح، كن في وسطنا، صارخاً قائلاً:

transliterations.english: Nai ekiri empoumevi: o Penneeb Pi-ekhristos: ekeshopi khen tenmeeti: ekosh evol ekgo emmos.

coptic: Ϫⲉ ⲧⲁϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ: ϯϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ: ⲧ̀ϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲁⲓⲱⲧ: ϯⲭⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ.

translations.english: "My peace I, give to you, the peace of My Father, I leave with you."
translations.arabic: "سلامي أنا، أعطيكم، سلام أبي، أتركه معكم."

transliterations.english: Je tahireenee anok: titi emmos noten: ethireenee empaiot: tiko emmos nemoten.

coptic: Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.

translations.english: O King of peace, grant us Your peace, render unto us Your peace, and forgive us our sins.
translations.arabic: يا ملك السلام، أعطنا سلامك، قرر لنا سلامك، وإغفر لنا خطايانا.

transliterations.english: Epouro ente tihireenee: moi nan entekhireenee: semni nan entekhireenee: ka nennovi nan evol.

coptic: Ϫⲱⲣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϫⲁϫⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ϯⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲟⲃⲧ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲕⲓⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.

translations.english: Disperse the enemies, of the Church, and fortify her that she, may not be shaken forever.
translations.arabic: فرِّق أعداء الكنيسة، وحصنها، فلا تتزعزع، إلى الأبد.

transliterations.english: Gor evol ennigaji: ente Tiekkleesia: arisovt eros: enneskim sha eneh.

coptic: Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲙⲏϯ ϯⲛⲟⲩ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.

translations.english: Emmanuel our God, is now in our midst, with the glory of His Father, and the Holy Spirit.
translations.arabic: عمانوئيل إلهنا، في وسطنا الآن، بمجد أبيه، والروح القدس.

transliterations.english: Emmanoweel Pennoti: khen tenmeeti tinou: khen epoou ente Pefiot: nem Pi-epnevma ethowab.

sung.english: Emmanuel our God, is in our midst, with the glory of His Father, and the Holy Spirit.

coptic: Ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲁⲗϭⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϣⲱⲛⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲥⲱⲙⲁ.

translations.english: May He bless us all, and purify our hearts, and heal the sicknesses, of our souls and bodies.
translations.arabic: ليباركنا كلنا، ويطهر قلوبنا، ويشفي أمراض، نفوسنا وأجسادنا.

transliterations.english: Entefesmou eron teeren: enteftouvo ennenheet: enteftalcho ennishoni: ente nenpsishee nem nensoma.

sung.english: May He bless us all, and purify our hearts, and heal the sicknesses, of our soul and bodies.

coptic: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ϫⲉ (ⲁⲕⲧⲱⲛⲕ/ ⲁⲕⲓ̀) ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ.

translations.english: We worship You O Christ, with Your good Father, and the Holy Spirit, for You have (risen/come) and saved us.
translations.arabic: نسجد لك أيها المسيح، مع إبيك الصالح، والروح القدس، لأنك (قمت/أتيت) وخلصتنا.

transliterations.english: Tenowosht emmok o Pi-ekhristos: nem Pekiot enaghathos: nem Pi-epnevma ethowab: je (aktonk/ aki) aksoti emmon.

sung.english: We worship You O Christ, with Your good Father, and the Holy Spirit, for You have (risen) and saved us.
